recap.text: Carl and Donut collect three common utility cards after the fight: two Time Extends and a Stout card. Donut buffs Geraldo the monk seal with Stout, then lands a Time Extend for sixty more seconds, but the second will not go, since uncommon totems hold only two utility cards. Carl works out that a Glow-Up would make a Time Extend permanent. As the Midnight Express timer ends, he tosses a Time Extend onto Raul the crab.

beats.headline: Not consumable
beats.text: After the fight, Carl and Donut collect three common utility cards: two Time Extends, which double the time a summoned totem lasts, and a Stout card. Unlike their combo card, these are not one-time consumables. Team Sister Ines receives three cards as well: two more Time Extends, and an uncommon special card called Flee.
beats.gist: Carl and Donut collect three common utility cards, including two Time Extends, which are not one-time consumables.

beats.headline: Two buffs, no more
beats.text: With Geraldo the monk seal summoned and the enemy on its way, Donut tries the utility cards on him. After a Stout card has buffed his health, she activates the first Time Extend, and it lands on the seal with a comic-book explosion: sixty more seconds on his timer. The second will not go: uncommon totems can only hold two utility cards.
beats.gist: Donut summons Geraldo the seal, buffs him with a Stout card, and adds one Time Extend.

beats.headline: Made permanent
beats.text: A consumable special card called Glow-Up changes a card so it permanently reflects its current state, and Carl works out what that means for Time Extend. A totem with a summoning time of 120 seconds, buffed with a time extend and then given the Glow-Up, would summon for 240 seconds in every battle after. Glow-Up can only be used once, so the buffs will have to be stacked with care.
beats.gist: Carl learns Glow-Up makes a buffed card permanent, so a 120-second totem could summon for 240, once.

beats.headline: Onto the crab
beats.text: Deckmaster for three minutes on a beach of dead seals, Carl holds Golden Combo, a Time Extend and the card he came for, Raul the crab. He flips Raul into the water, and when the crab has finally been told what he is there to do, Carl tosses the time extend onto him just as the Midnight Express timer ends.
beats.gist: Carl flips Raul the crab into the water, then tosses a Time Extend onto him.
